cards.title: Craft Beer
cards.text: From a Citra-soaked IPA and a clean German pilsner to a Madagascar-vanilla stout, brewed in small batches on our 7-barrel system.
cards.text_es: Desde una IPA cargada de Citra y una pilsner alemana limpia hasta una stout con vainilla de Madagascar, en lotes pequeños en nuestro sistema de 7 barriles.

cards.title: Fruit Ciders
cards.text: Gluten-free ciders pressed with Costa Rican fruit. Try the Cas Cider, made from 100% cas, or the Maracas Cider with extra maracuyá.
cards.text_es: Sidras sin gluten hechas con fruta costarricense. Pruebe la Sidra de Cas, 100% cas, o la Sidra Maracuyá con aún más maracuyá.
cards.alt: Cas Cider label: monkey in sunglasses with a glass of cider and cas fruit

cards.title: Cocktails
cards.text: Not a beer drinker? The bar is stocked with spirits and mixers for cocktails, so everyone in your group has something to sip.
cards.text_es: ¿No toma cerveza? Tenemos licores y mezcladores para cócteles, así que todo el grupo tiene algo para disfrutar.
